product.olivetti-philos-33-color.summary: The Philos 33 with a colour screen and built-in voice recording.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.history: The Philos 33 was offered in monochrome and colour. The Ivrea museum dates the family introduction to 1992, while the Historical Archive and L’Unità document its 1993 presentation.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.archite: The microphone and speaker supported recording and playback of voice notes. The PCMCIA slot could add peripherals.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.verifie: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.limitat: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.archive: Associazione Archivio Storico Olivetti, Olivetti Philos, MAN0908.
product.olivetti-philos-33-color.unita: L’Unità, 8 June 1993, Olivetti portable range presentation.
